description: The file defines the ListViewSmarty class, which extends ListViewDisplay, responsible for rendering list views with Smarty templates in the SuiteCRM application, including handling actions like building confirmation emails, processing list view data, and rendering HTML output.

classes.name: ListViewSmarty
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering list views with Smarty templates, including features like inline editing, context menus, mass update, and pagination.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ListViewSmarty object and parent class, sets up Smarty object.

methods.name: buildSendConfirmOptInEmailToPersonAndCompany
methods.description: Builds a confirmation email link if the configuration allows.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes list view data and prepares Smarty variables for rendering.

methods.name: processArrows
methods.description: Assigns sorting arrow images and attributes for the list view.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the list view by fetching the Smarty template with assigned variables.

methods.name: getSearchIcon
methods.description: Returns the HTML for the search icon link.

methods.name: displayEnd
methods.description: Returns additional HTML content at the end of the list view, such as mass update forms.
